newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Bridgecon aborts bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Bridgecon aborts bonus issue.

text.p: Malaysian civil engineering firm Bridgecon Bhd said on Thursday its proposed one-for-two bonus issue of 9.975 million new shares will be aborted.

Bridgecon said in a statement it has revised an earlier proposed three-for-four rights issue of 14.96 million shares at 4.95 ringgit per share, to an issue of 39.9 million shares at 13.0 ringgit each on the basis of two new shares for every one share held.
A proposed rights issue of 19.95 million ringgit 5.0 percent irredeemable convertible unsecured loan stocks (ICULS) has also been revised to an issue worth 29.925 million ringgit.

Bridgecon said the decision to abort the bonus issue and revise the rights issues was due to its proposed acquisition of several pieces of land totalling 4,208 acres from Berjaya Group Bhd for 462.9 million ringgit cash.
Proceeds from the rights issues would be used to finance acquisition of the land and a project development as well as to repay bank borrowings and for working capital, it said.
The revised proposals are subject to approval of the relevant authorities including the Securities Commission.
Bridgecon's paid-up capital will increase to 89.775 million ringgit from the existing 19.95 million after completion of the proposals.
